weekly-banners.title: A new featured pantheon every week
weekly-banners.body: Each week one tradition gets half of the rare results. The odds stay printed on the altar.

fortuna.body: A free turn every eight hours, offerings at the altar, a daily tribute, and a golden tessera every 200 summons.

workshop.body: Dress your cards in pantheon frames, dissolve spares into stardust, and buy the cards you miss from the Oracle.
